## Checklist

- [ ] `ruff check .`, `ruff format --check .`, `mypy` and `pytest` pass
- [ ] New behaviour has tests
- [ ] If this touches a security property in `docs/threat-model.md`, a test proves it still holds
- [ ] No secrets, real hostnames or real addresses
- [ ] No content taken from a site that hosts illegal material, including in tests and fixtures
- [ ] Commits use a no-reply identity
- [ ] Documentation updated if behaviour changed
